description.value: BNA Brewing Co. is a locally owned craft brewery, eatery, and entertainment venue occupying a restored century-old brick warehouse — originally a British North American Tobacco Company facility — in downtown Kelowna since 2015. All beer is brewed on-site and served alongside a full food menu featuring shareable, culturally-inspired dishes, cocktails, and local Okanagan wine. The venue also houses six 10-pin bowling lanes, making it a lively stop in the heart of the Okanagan.

Takeout is confirmed via 'growler fills, tasting flights and 4packs are available in both the BNA Tasting Room and Eatery' and the shop=alcohol OSM tag.
